svg.text: Class-A CMOS OP — white-line layout plan
vertical-finger MOS arrays · shared S/D · dummies at both W ends · one ring per matched group
PMOS bulk=VDD · NMOS bulk=VSS · one DNW · one NW/PW well · W=finger height, L=finger width, m=fingers
DNW (one) · NW/PW one well · not a DRC rule
scale bar · each finger is a vertical MOS stripe; S/D shared between adjacent fingers
d = dummy finger (same W/L, S/D shared)
M13: PMOS current source; M14: output
